newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolian airport expanded to receive jumbos.
newsitem.headline: Mongolian airport expanded to receive jumbos.

text.p: Mongolia has completed the expansion of Ulan Bator airport which can now handle jumbo jets, a civil aviation official said on Wednesday.
"Now we can handle any kind of aircraft, including Boeing 747s, and services are on an international level," airport general manager T. Baljinnyam said in an interview.
The airport had extended its runways to 3,100 metres from 2,100 and widened them to 60 metres from 49, he said.
The expansion had been funded by a loan of $36 million from the Asian Development Bank and an ADB loan of $24 million would be used to renew the airport's navigation system.

"Our country is a place that connects Asia and Europe and many international planes will land here after the expansion of the capacity," Baljinnyam said. "Also the number of planes passing through Mongolian airspace will increase."
